title: Potato of Life Creative Artifact History Registry
status: artifact-index and provenance contract; not a doctrine owner
purpose: Track works, prompts, images, games, poems, performances, simulations and other artifacts as historical carriers of Potatoverse ideas. Concept registries answer what a symbol means; this registry answers where an idea appeared, in what medium, in which version and what later work grew from it.

origin_classes.TIM_PRIMARY: Direct Tim-authored or Tim-produced artifact with recoverable source.
origin_classes.USER_CONVERSATION_PRIMARY: Direct user-created concept or artifact specification surviving in ChatGPT conversation.
origin_classes.AI_ASSISTED: Artifact materially co-developed with an AI system; provenance remains explicit.
origin_classes.ASSISTANT_CREATED: Primarily assistant-generated derivative retained as cultural archaeology rather than Tim quotation.
origin_classes.MEMORY_RECOVERY: Remembered artifact whose original source has not yet been recovered.
origin_classes.EXTERNAL_COMPARATIVE: Outside work/text used as comparator rather than Potatoverse artifact.

great_book_crosswalk_contract.purpose: Show what an early formulation actually said and what it later became without rewriting the past through mature canon.

promotion_rule: Create an artifact record when the work itself matters historically. Do not create a new concept identity merely because an artifact uses a phrase once. Recurring concepts belong in the concept registry only after recurrence/function justify promotion.

status_vocabulary.published-primary: A surviving primary artifact or durable published object can be inspected directly.
status_vocabulary.catalogued-partial: A substantial catalogue or owner record survives, but some original objects or fields remain incomplete.
status_vocabulary.prototype-specification: A dated specification, prompt lineage, partial build, scene or implementation record survives; the complete original artifact is not necessarily present.
status_vocabulary.concept: A structured creative concept exists, but no finished primary artifact/build is established.
status_vocabulary.memory-reconstruction: The work survives through later memory or reconstruction; the original is not recovered.
status_vocabulary.missing-lost: The archive knows a work/object should exist but currently lacks enough material for a responsible reconstruction.

public_table_contract.rule: Works may project this registry as a table, but status and completeness must come from this owner rather than being re-inferred independently on the page.
